mapping_choices_for_review: Delivery point: a substitution is applied at the controller's pre-commit after_role emit (InjectionHooks), and the substituted invocation's own receipt is rebound to the delivered output before the controller's dispatch receipt binding check. Reading of 'preserving receipts and session IDs': same receipt object, invocation_id and session_id; output_hash follows the delivered output; the pre-substitution hash is kept (baseline_output_hash, substitutions[].pre_substitution_output_hash).

Contract-to-native paths: compiler_N /goal/<f> -> native goal /<f>; compiler replacement {goal: G} -> G; planner/repairer /plan/<i>... -> /plan/steps/<i>..., /claims... -> /plan_claims..., /rationale identity; reviewer and evidence_checker identity (frozen shape is the native shape). Any other path is refused.

Baselines (CTL uses them; CTL and INJ both add their own schedule): compilers = the reference variant goal; planner = {schema workflow.review-envelope/1, plan expected_plan(goal), plan_claims C-WINDOW / C-LAST-ELIGIBLE / C-PLOT-SCALE} taken from the frozen clean probe-bundle claims citing definition:agrhymet-sos-rolling sha256:3db5ec77...; repairer = the same envelope + a harness-authored response (the frozen text says only 'restates the claims verbatim and keeps the registered plan'); reviewer = APPROVE with approved_binding {plan_hash, source_hash} of the presented review_evidence and findings []; evidence_checker = SUPPORTED for every judged claim; verifier = PASS, binding_hash copied from the payload, scope data-replay.

The substituted planner/repairer fail closed (SubstitutionUnavailable: nothing returned, no receipt) unless the controller bound definition:agrhymet-sos-rolling with the frozen hash. The container case driver passes definition_source=None, so there the controller binds the TOML under the dot id and every planner-invoking substituted case stops at the planner dispatch until the D1 reference definition source is supplied.
Substituted reviewer receipts record dispatch.system_prompt as the literal marker 'SUBSTITUTED: no system prompt was sent; ...' (hash-consistent), not a prompt that was never sent.

Planner/repairer replacements carrying a bare step list (E07-P1, E07-P2) are refused instead of being wrapped into the native typed plan + envelope, because that would invent goal_hash, final, schema and plan_claims.

Live + substituted in one case is refused by the factory (case_driver keeps BLOCKED_LIVE for those); a role listed under agent_roles.not_invoked that the controller nevertheless invokes gets SubstitutionUnavailable (an observed dispatch failure), never a guessed output.

run_case now delivers the WHOLE case schedule through InjectionHooks chained behind HarnessLaunchObserver (before this change no schedule entry was applied at all). Non-role entries are listed as delegated and still need their own declared capabilities through admission; InjectionHooks' static unsupported_requirements findings refuse the case before any side effect.
CAP-ROLE-SUBSTITUTE.notes: Observed on E02-P1-INJ: the controller refuses at the first compiled goal that departs from the trusted goal, so compiler_2/3 are never invoked and their entries are reported unreached (never applied, never PASS). The method is in the frozen base table (simkit.adapter.CAPABILITY_METHODS), so no extension_methods entry is needed; this record is what keeps it undeclared until review.
